scripts.install:all: cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail "node backend/index.js" "cd frontend && npm run dev" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && start chrome http://localhost:5173"
scripts.dev:remote: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n frontend,tunnel,browser "cd frontend && npm run dev" "powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File server/vtube-tunnel.ps1" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && start chrome http://localhost:5173"
